subject: english
question:
**Select the option that expresses the given sentence in direct speech.**

The teacher ordered the students to go straight to their classrooms.

options.text: “Go straight to your classrooms,” the teacher said to the students.
“Go straight to their classrooms,” the teacher said to the students.
The teacher said to the students, “Please go straight to your classrooms.”
The teacher said, “Students, to go straight to their classrooms.”

solution:
​The correct answer is **“Go straight to your classrooms,” the teacher said to the students.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in Indirect Speech. As per the question we have to change it into Direct Speech. 
 
• The process of transformation is as follows:
 
 
• The given sentence is an example of an imperative sentence.
 
• Let's look at the rules of transformation:
 
• While changing the narration of an **imperative sentence,** we need to follow the given steps:
 
 
• The notion of the given sentence is '**request**'.
 
• The conjunction 'to' should be used in place of a **comma** (,) and **inverted commas** (“ ”). '**said**' will be changed into '**asked**'.
 
• '**to**' is followed by '**V1**'.
 
• *Example:*
 
 
• *The queen said to his servant, "Cook me some delicious food today." (Direct Speech)*
 
• *The queen ordered his servant to cook her some delicious food that day. (Indirect Speech)*

 
 
 
 
 
 
 

**Correct Sentence:__*** “Go straight to your classrooms,” the teacher said to the students.* [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/51867102c7c2f369f6e29d2efe025e3b3367c68261ec20262828d84ca5c8f854.png] **__Hinglish__**

 
• दिया गया वाक्य Direct Speech में है। प्रश्न के अनुसार हमें इसे Indirect Speech में बदलना होगा।
 
• परिवर्तन की प्रक्रिया इस प्रकार है:
 
 
• दिया गया वाक्य Imperative Sentence का उदाहरण है।
 
• आइए परिवर्तन के नियमों को देखें:
 
 
• एक Imperative Sentence का Narration बदलते समय, हमें दिए गए चरणों का पालन करना होगा:
 
• दिए गए वाक्य की धारणा 'request' है।
 
• संयोजन 'to' का प्रयोग अल्पविराम (,) और उल्टे अल्पविराम (" ") के स्थान पर किया जाना चाहिए।
 
• 'said' को 'asked' में बदल दिया जाएगा।
 
• 'to' के बाद 'V1' आता है।
 
• *Example:*
 
 
• *The queen said to his servant, "Cook me some delicious food today." (Direct Speech)*
 
• *The queen ordered his servant to cook her some delicious food that day. (Indirect Speech)*
